_todo: PLACEHOLDER BRAND. 'Northcourt' is a stand-in so nothing is hardcoded — replace brandName, merchBrand and domain once the real name is chosen. Do NOT use 'Handball Canada': that is the national federation's legal name and implies an endorsement that does not exist.

merch._todo: Merch line name. Keep it distinct from the federation. Fulfilment source is swappable — see components/BuyPanel.tsx.

fund._todo: DECIDE THE BASIS BEFORE LAUNCH. 'basis' drives every piece of copy on the site; changing it here changes it everywhere. Options: 'merch-sales' (10% of merch revenue — recommended, you control that margin), 'all-sales' (10% of all revenue — ~25-40% of total gross profit at normal retail margins), 'profit' (10% of net profit). Canadian Competition Act s.74.01 treats unsubstantiated donation claims as deceptive marketing, so whatever is stated here must be what actually happens and must be reported.

commitment.en: 10% of every dollar our merch line takes in goes straight back into growing handball in Canada.
commitment.fr: 10 % de chaque dollar généré par notre ligne de vêtements est réinvesti dans la croissance du handball au Canada.

partnerNote.fr: Le Fonds est notre propre initiative. Nous ne sommes ni affiliés à Handball Canada ou à une fédération provinciale, ni approuvés ou mandatés par elles.
